en.hubeali:
Al Husayn Bin Muhammad, from Moalla Bin Muhammad, from Al Washa, from Aban, from Zurara, 
(It has been narrated) from Abu Abdullah<sup style="font-weight: normal">asws</sup> having said:

‘Amir Al-Momineenasws said upon the pulpit: ‘Not one of you would find the food of the Emān until he knows that whatever hit him would not have missed him, and whatever missed him, would not have hit him’.
en.sarwar: 4. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad has narrated from Mu’alla ibn Muhammad from al- Washsha’ from Aban from Zurara from abu ‘Abd Allah (a.s.) who has said the following:

“Amir al-Mu’minin (Ali ibn abu Talib) (a.s.) once said from the pulpit, ‘No one among you can ever sense the taste of belief until he comes to know that whatever has happened right could not have happened wrong and whatever has happened wrong could not have happened right.’”
